parameters.name: DBInstanceName
parameters.description: The instance ID. > You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: DstDb
parameters.description: The execution status of the target SQL import. Valid values: * **importing**: importing. * **success**: import succeeded. * **fail**: import failed.

parameters.name: DstPassword
parameters.description: The password of the privileged account for the target ApsaraDB RDS instance. > * You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the privileged account information of the target instance, including the password. * This parameter takes effect only when DstPassword is set to true.

parameters.name: DstUserName
parameters.description: The username of the target instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the instance resides. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.

parameters.name: SrcDb
parameters.description: The database information of the migration source when the source database is ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL. > The source database must be consistent with the target database.

parameters.name: SrcPassword
parameters.description: The read/write mode for executing the import task on the source instance. Valid values: * **rw**: read/write. * **ro**: read-only.

parameters.name: SrcResId
parameters.description: The ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. > You can call the [DescribeDrivingAccess](~~196830~~) operation to query the details of all source ApsaraDB RDS instances in the target region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: SrcUserName
parameters.description: The username of the source instance.
